tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground of the operator console. Dark is the default: ops rooms run dim so the camera feeds carry the light.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, vehicle tiles, the alert rail.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised controls on surface-1: button fills, inputs, selected rows.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of surface-2 controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel edges. Separation comes from lines and surface steps, never drop shadows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and focus-independent outlines; 3:1 on surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and units on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 (4.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder hints only; never for information an operator needs.

tokens.name: carbon
tokens.usage: Satin Carbon. The hardware body color and the ground of the mark. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Graphite. Secondary hardware shells (rear wheel shell, column) and the dark faceplate.

tokens.name: robot-white
tokens.usage: Robot White. Light hardware variant and the original station's shell color.

tokens.name: gum
tokens.usage: Gum. TPE grip overmold and feet, after the Tarmac's tanwall tires. Hardware only; not a UI color.

tokens.name: alloy
tokens.usage: Alloy. Bead-blast anodized aluminium (tilt drum, dial) and the reflective wordmark print.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Signal Mint, the brand accent and the AUTONOMY state. In dark it is a fill and text color on surface-0..2; in light it darkens to stay 4.5:1 as text.

tokens.name: mint-fill
tokens.usage: Mint as a solid fill (primary button, LED halo). Text on it uses on-mint.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on mint-fill.

tokens.name: mint-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind autonomy badges and the autonomy row highlight.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Operator Amber, the OPERATOR-IN-CONTROL state: a human is driving. Text and icon color on surface-0..2.

tokens.name: amber-fill
tokens.usage: Amber as a solid fill (claimed-vehicle banner, LED halo while operator has control). Text on it uses on-amber.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on amber-fill.

tokens.name: amber-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind operator badges and the claimed row.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: Stop Red. Emergency stop, critical alerts, lost link. Never decorative and never for anything that is not a stop or a critical fault.

tokens.name: stop-fill
tokens.usage: Solid stop red: the E-stop cap, the E-stop banner. Text on it uses on-stop.

tokens.name: on-stop
tokens.usage: Text on stop-fill (5.0:1).

tokens.name: stop-wash
tokens.usage: Ground behind critical alert rows.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational alerts and links. Blue, so it never competes with the three control-state colors.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid at a 2px offset, so it always lands on a surface token (16:1 there), never on the control fill.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing and case-study headlines only. Archivo at wdth 125 (expanded) italic: set font-stretch: 125% and font-style: italic.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Console takeover banner and full-screen state changes. Expanded, upright.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Alert titles, vehicle names, section heads inside panels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Vehicle stopped 4 m before the crosswalk and is waiting for the pedestrian to clear.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and badge text. Always uppercase with tracking.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Big live numbers: latency, speed. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Vehicle IDs, coordinates, timestamps, log lines.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Hardware uses the same steps in mm for button pitch and edge clearances.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page margins on the wall display.

radius.note: One radius family across screen and shell: small radii on detail, large on primary forms. Hardware: R2 detail, R6 buttons, R12 faceplate, R24 base plan.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycap glyph corners, focus ring on small chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, alert rows, vehicle tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the camera viewport frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Control-state badge, link meter, hold-to-confirm track.

duration.note: Kept as data for consumers; the page does not render motion.

tokens.name: pulse-transition
tokens.usage: LED halo and badge pulse while control is transitioning.

tokens.name: hold-confirm
tokens.usage: Hold time for Release vehicle, on hardware and screen.

scene.note: Imagery palette for scene objects (components/SceneObjects). Theme-independent: camera views look the same in Ops dark and Daylight. Mirrors kit.palette in scene-kit.js.

tokens.name: scene-paint
tokens.usage: The only four car paints: silver, carbon, white, slate blue.

tokens.name: scene-shirt
tokens.usage: Pedestrian and cyclist tops.

tokens.name: scene-pants
tokens.usage: Trousers.

tokens.name: scene-skin
tokens.usage: Skin tones.

tokens.name: scene-glass
tokens.usage: Vehicle glass and building windows.

tokens.name: scene-shuttle
tokens.usage: Gen 2 shuttle body, robot white.

tokens.name: scene-bus
tokens.usage: City bus body.

tokens.name: scene-cone
tokens.usage: Cones and barrier stripes. Never used for state.

tokens.name: scene-amber-lamp
tokens.usage: Hazard and warning lamps only.

tokens.name: scene-taillight
tokens.usage: Tail lights only.

tokens.name: scene-halo
tokens.usage: Shuttle halo strip. The only state colours in a scene; must match ControlState.

tokens.name: scene-foliage
tokens.usage: Tree crowns.

tokens.name: scene-building
tokens.usage: Facade base tones.

tokens.name: scene-ground
tokens.usage: Ground layers.

tokens.name: scene-sky
tokens.usage: Background and fog.
